source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p3) p10
s: Who founded Bhagya Nagar?
x: Muhammad Quli Qutb Shah built a new capital around Chichlam village on a grid pattern in 1591. Tavernier noted it was locally called Bhagnagar after Muhammad Quli's beloved Bhagmati.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p3) p10
s: Identify the misalignment
x: The Nanaghat inscription belongs to Naganika, not Rudradaman.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p3) p10
s: 'Ghatika' is the residence of?
x: Vedic schools affiliated to Hindu temples in South India were called Ghatikas. Vishnukundina king Indrabhattaraka Varma built many Ghatikas.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p3) p10
s: Alluri Sitaramaraj's tomb is located here?
x: Alluri Sitaramaraju was shot dead near Rajendrapalem on 7 May 1924 by Major Goodall. He was buried in Krishna Devi Peta.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p3) p10
s: Who started Viveka Vardini magazine?
x: Kandukuri Veeresalingam started Vivekavardhini in 1874.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p3) p10
s: Who wrote 'Katantra Vyakaranam'?
x: At the request of Kuntala Satakarni, Sharvavarma wrote the Katantra Vyakaranam so that everyone could learn Sanskrit easily.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p3) p10
s: With whom did the Cholas maintain political and marital relations?
x: Rajendra II of the Vengi Chalukyas married Chola princess Madhurantaki and later merged the Vengi and Chola kingdoms, ruling as Kulottunga Chola-I (1070-1122).

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p3) p10
s: The first dynasty to rule Andhra?
x: The Satavahanas brought all the Telugu regions under one rule for the first time.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p3) p10
s: The Panchayat Raj system of Andhra Pradesh was introduced during which of the following Chief Ministers?
x: The three-tier panchayat raj system was introduced on 1 November 1959 when Neelam Sanjeeva Reddy was CM. AP was the second state after Rajasthan to implement it.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p3) p10
s: Which Chalukya King got/had the title "Tripura-Martya Mahesvara"?
x: Gunaga Vijayaditya conquered the three cities of Nellore, Achala and Kirana and so took the title Tripuramartyamaheshwara.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p3) p10
s: What is the Sahitya mandir (literary palace) of the Devaraya-II called?
x: Devaraya-II's literary hall was Mutyala Sala; Sri Krishnadevaraya's was Bhuvana Vijayam.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p3) p10
s: The Battle of Bobbili was held in the year of?
x: In the Battle of Bobbili on 24 January 1757, the French chief Bussy defeated Ranga Rao, the zamindar of Bobbili.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p3) p10
s: What is the Tenali bomb case related to?
x: The Tenali Bomb Case (1909) was one of the events of the Vande Mataram (Swadeshi) Movement.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p3) p10
s: Who translated Mitakshara of Vigyaneshwar into Telugu?
x: Ketana, a disciple of Tikkana, translated Vigyaneshwara's Mitakshara into Telugu as 'Vigyaneshwareeyam', the first dharma sastra in Telugu.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p3) p11
s: President's rule was imposed in Andhra Pradesh in 1973 due to which of the following?
x: During the Jai Andhra movement (1972-73), P.V. Narasimha Rao resigned as CM on 17 January 1973 and President's rule was imposed on 18 January.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p3) p11
s: Who wrote 'Madhura Vijayam'?
x: Kampana's wife Gangadevi wrote the Sanskrit drama Madhuravijayam (Kamparaya Vijayam) recounting her husband's conquest of the Madurai Sultanate.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p3) p11
s: Who is popularly known as 'Andhra Shivaji'?
x: Parvataneni Veeraiah Chaudhary of Pedanandipadu, popularly known as the Shivaji of Andhra, led the no-tax movement.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p3) p11
s: What was the occasion to release the 'Kurnool Circular' by state Congress leaders?
x: During the Quit India movement, Kala Venkatarao prepared the Andhra Circular at a meeting in Pattabhi Sitaramaiah's house on 29 July 1942. It is also known as the Kurnool Circular as the police got it from the Kurnool office.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p3) p11
s: 'Nritya Ratnavali' was composed by Jayapa Senani during whose reign?
x: Ganapatideva appointed Jayapasenani as Gajasahini; Jayapa wrote Nritta Ratnavali, Geetaratnavali and Vadyaratnavali in Sanskrit.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p3) p11
s: Vijayanagara king who completely abolished marriage tax?
x: According to Paes and Nuniz, Sri Krishnadevaraya abolished the Kalyana Kanike (marriage tax). Sadashivaraya abolished the Mangali (barber) tax.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p3) p11
s: Rampa Rebellion took place during?
x: The Rampa Rebellion lasted about 2 years and 5 months, from January 1922 to May 1924, in the agency areas of East Godavari and Visakhapatnam.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p3) p11
s: Who were the main opponents of the Vijayanagara kings?
x: Vijayanagara kings had frequent clashes with the Bahmanis over the Krishna-Tungabhadra (Raichur) doab.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p3) p11
s: What was the administrative unit of the Vijayanagara Empire?
x: A military governor called Nayaka was given Amarams for the salaries and army expenses; this is called the Amara Nayankara system.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p3) p11
s: Which is the first Sanskrit rock inscription?
x: Rudradaman of the Kardamaka Saka dynasty issued the Junagadh/Girnar inscription, the first Sanskrit inscription in India.

Mention the following in historical chronological order?

b) Kondaveeti Reddy's
c) Kakatiyas of Warangal
d) Vijayanagara Kings
e) Gajapati's of Orissa
x: Kakatiyas 995 AD, Kondaveeti Reddis 1325 AD, Vijayanagara 1336 AD, Bahmanis 1347 AD, Gajapatis of Orissa 1434 AD.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p3) p11
s: Find the different one
x: Sangama, Saluva and Tuluva were dynasties of the Vijayanagara Empire; the Vishnukundinas ruled Andhra after the Ikshvakus.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p3) p11

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p3) p11

x: Anandacharya presided over the seventh Congress session at Nagpur in 1891, the first Andhra person to hold that post.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p3) p12

x: In 1798 Nizam Ali Khan made a subsidiary alliance, handing over defence and foreign affairs to the British. He was the first ruler to sign this agreement.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p3) p12

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p3) p12

x: Vinukonda Vallabharaya's Kridabhiramamu, a Telugu version of Ravipati Tripurantaka's Premabhiramam, describes Orugallu (Warangal).

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p3) p12

x: The oldest Shiva Lingam in Andhra Pradesh is at Gudimallam in Chittoor district.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p3) p12

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p3) p12

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p3) p12

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p3) p13

x: The oldest Shiva Lingam in Andhra is at Gudimallam in Chittoor district, dating to the Satavahana period.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p3) p14

x: Nuniz, a Portuguese, came during Achyuta Devaraya's reign and described Vijayanagara after Krishnadevaraya's death.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p3) p14

x: Rudradeva (Prataparudra-I) built the thousand pillared Rudreswara temple at Hanumakonda.

x: At the Battle of Chandurthi near Rajahmundry on 7 December 1758, Colonel Forde defeated the French under Conflans.

x: Sir Thomas Munro died of cholera on 6 July 1827 at Pattikonda, Kurnool district.

x: Ashoka's Prakrit-language, Brahmi-script inscriptions at Yerragudi and Rajula Mandagiri in Kurnool district refer to the Andhras.

x: An AICC meeting was held at Vijayawada from 31 March to 1 April 1921 under the chairmanship of Mahatma Gandhi.
